$tables = []
def create_table(name, **options)
 if options.key?(:charset)
  raise "bad charset" unless ["utf8mb4", "latin1"].include?(options[:charset])
 end
 if options.key?(:collation)
  raise "bad collation" unless ["utf8mb4_unicode_ci", "latin1_bin"].include?(options[:collation])
 end
 yield(name) if block_given?
 $tables << [name, options[:id], options[:metadata]]
 options
end
create_table :widgets, id: false, metadata: {tag: :kept}
p $tables
